summary: The branch-pr control plane now consistently treats the resolved task branch snapshot as authoritative for task state and PR metadata, while direct mode retains base-local reads.
findings: A resolved task branch returns its own PR metadata result, including missing metadata, so a stale base meta.json cannot authorize or distort the route.
residual_risks: The stale runner reclaim test is red on untouched main as well as this branch; it is recorded as an independent follow-up before release.
